description:
Found while re-pricing the three receive_* fixtures fz-kdt.119 moved (2026-09-01).

Every fixture frontmatter carrying budget.* keys states TEN numbers and only
ONE has a producer: budget.codegen.functions is fz.codegen.define_function.stop
from `fz2 --emit=stats`. The other nine -- budget.codegen.instructions and the
eight budget.planner.* keys (worklist_pops, walk_calls, type_fn_calls,
matcher_specs, vars, blocks, stmts, dispatches) -- name a 'planner' that does
not exist in compiler2; grep finds no emitter for any of them, only the
frontmatter parser (fixture_metadata.rs:273) that files them into
BudgetAssertion, which nothing then reads. Nothing enforces any of the ten:
fixture_matrix never asserts a budget.

So the headers are unenforced numbers that no reader can reproduce, and they
drift silently: receive_map_pattern read 26 while the truth was 32 BEFORE
fz-kdt.119 touched it, receive_shared_tuple_arity reads 18 against a measured
45. That is worse than no number.

Fix direction, corpus-wide: keep budget.codegen.functions and make the matrix
ASSERT it (a real gate, re-priced with cause when it moves, per the fz-zih
classification rule); delete the nine keys that name nothing, along with the
BudgetAssertion plumbing if nothing else wants it. Re-measure every fixture in
one pass while deleting -- most are stale.

fz-kdt.119 re-priced budget.codegen.functions on its three movers
(receive_map_pattern 26->46, receive_list_cons_pattern 29->49,
receive_interleaved_tuple_arity 29->49) and recorded the measurement recipe in
each header; it did not touch the other seven keys or the rest of the corpus.
title: Fixture budget headers name counters nothing produces
